recognize_zh: 油鏡下 mucicarmine 染色，大小不一的圓形酵母菌外圍都有鮮洋紅色的莢膜環，部分菌體周圍還有放射狀淡紅暈；菌體散在於淡色組織球之間，下方有深紫色淋巴細胞群。洋紅色莢膜是 Cryptococcus 的決定性特徵。
features: Round yeast forms of variable size with bright carmine-red mucicarmine-positive capsules
Capsular material forms sharp rings, some with a fuzzy radiating pink halo
Occasional budding and collapsed/folded yeast forms
Organisms lie within and between pale vacuolated histiocytes
Dense cluster of small dark lymphoid nuclei at the bottom of the field
describe_en: Lymph node biopsy, mucicarmine stain under oil immersion, shows numerous round yeast forms of variable size within and between pale vacuolated histiocytes. The yeasts have mucicarmine-positive, carmine-red capsules forming sharp rings, some with a radiating halo, and occasional budding forms are present; residual lymphocytes are seen at the lower edge. Findings are consistent with cryptococcal lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Blastomyces may show faint mucicarmine staining of the wall but lacks a thick capsule and shows broad-based budding.
Histoplasma yeasts are much smaller, uniform and mucicarmine negative.
Capsule-deficient strains may be mucicarmine weak, in which case Fontana-Masson (melanin) positivity supports Cryptococcus.
Signet ring cells contain intracellular mucin with a compressed nucleus and are keratin positive, unlike extracellular capsule-bearing yeasts.
